tactic_record.goal: Reduce valuable-stack counterattack exposure when a low-value stack can legally consume a finite retaliation first
offense: Select a visible surviving finite-retaliation target
Ensure bait and main stack can act in the same combat round
Use only legal engine candidates; WAIT if legal and useful for the order
Observe actual COUNTER from target against bait
Attack that same surviving target with the main stack before the round resets
defense: Avoid treating a target's retaliation as exhausted without native evidence
Recognize unlimited-retaliation targets; do not sacrifice bait expecting exhaustion
Protect valuable stacks and compare alternative targets/order
failure_conditions: Target dies before the next hit, making absence of COUNTER ambiguous
Bait uses a no-retaliation ability and therefore does not consume the counter
Movement/WAIT order does not permit bait before main
Opportunity cost or bait loss exceeds the saved damage
unsupported_or_unknown: Exact state of the authors' described battles
Authors' unit counts, hexes, hero skills, morale and RNG
Exact game/mod patch used by these sources
A source-owned replay or actual human action trace
